text:
Noelle: Quick help 4b0
Our conference sponsorship was charged on the corp card but the vendor posted an extra 3.5% DCC/FX fee at settlement. The vendor invoice equals the base sponsorship (12,000 EUR) but the bank billed 12,420 EUR because the vendor offered dynamic currency conversion. Do we absorb the DCC or ask the event lead to cover it?
Grant: Do we have policy language on DCC? My read: if the vendor invoice matches the contracted amount and DCC was a merchant-level choice, company absorbs. If employee opted into DCC at POS or via personal card we ask for repayment.
Noelle: Charge was on the corp card and the event organizer (Alyssa) paid at the vendor portal. She says the vendor showed a pop-up and she clicked "pay in USD" without realizing it was DCC.
Alyssa: Yep that was me. I didn't notice the toggle. I can cover via bank transfer if that's easier.
Kofi: For audit, we need: vendor invoice (12,000 EUR), card statement showing 12,420 EUR, and a short note from the cardholder if they consent to cover net amount.
expense-bot: Flag: DCC discrepancy >1%. Policy: if cardholder knowingly selected DCC, reimbursement is limited to invoice amount; excess flagged for employee repayment unless manager approves absorbing cost.
Grant: Manager discretion matters. Since this was accidental, manager approval can direct Finance to absorb as a one-off, but we should log it as a policy exception. Who's the manager?
Alyssa: Manager is Priya. Priya approved to absorb this one time in DM but asked us to record the exception and update policy wording.
Noelle: Ok finance, what's the journal entry? Do we record the vendor invoice at 12,000 EUR and write off 420 EUR to Misc-Travel-Fees?
Kofi: Yes create GL: DR Sponsorship Expense 12,000 EUR / DR Travel Misc Fees 420 EUR / CR Card Payable 12,420 EUR. Accounting reference: GL-SPON-2024-06-DCC1. Tag as policy exception: EXC-DCC-2024-06-A1.
expense-bot: Reminder: Policy exceptions require manager signoff and a short rationale in Concur notes.
Noelle: I've added the Concur note: "Manager approved one-time absorption of DCC fee (Priya)." Uploaded invoice and card statement.
Grant: Can we also add a preventative line to travel/corp-card guidance: "Do not accept DCC prompts; pay in vendor currency when possible." I'll draft.
Alyssa: I'll reimburse if needed but good to have company cover this one. Thanks.
Kofi: I'll post the journal and tag GL-SPON-2024-06-DCC1 as posted. Closing once GL posted.
expense-bot: Action logged: exception EXC-DCC-2024-06-A1 created.
Kofi: Posted. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
